arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
title: Duniya aur Akhirat ki bhalai
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah, wa fil-akhirati hasanah, wa qina adhaban-nar.
urdu: Aye hamare Rab! Hamein duniya me bhalai de aur akhirat me bhi bhalai de, aur hamein dozakh ke azab se bacha.
virtue: Quran ki sab se jami' duaon me se — duniya aur akhirat dono ki bhalai ek sath mangti hai.

arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
title: Apne aur walidain ke liye maghfirat
transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
urdu: Aye hamare Rab! Mujhe, mere walidain ko aur sab momineen ko us din bakhsh de jab hisab qaim hoga.
virtue: Ibrahim (AS) ki dua — apne liye, walidain ke liye aur tamam momineen ke liye.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
title: Iman par sabit qadmi
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana, wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab.
urdu: Aye hamare Rab! Hidayat dene ke baad hamare dilon ko terha na kar, aur apne pas se hamein rehmat de. Beshak Tu hi sab se bara dene wala hai.
virtue: Hidayat ke baad gumrahi se bachne ki dua — dil ki salamti ke liye.

arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
title: Iman ke sadqe maghfirat
transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna, faghfir lana dhunubana, wa qina adhaban-nar.
urdu: Aye hamare Rab! Hum iman laye, pas hamare gunah bakhsh de aur hamein aag ke azab se bacha.
virtue: Allah ne momineen ki is sifat ko pasand farmaya — iman ka wasta de kar maghfirat mangna.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
title: Nek biwi, aulad aur kamyabi
transliteration: Rabbana hablana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yun, waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
urdu: Aye hamare Rab! Hamein hamari biwiyon aur aulad se aankhon ki thandak de, aur hamein muttaqeen ka imam bana.
virtue: Ibad-ur-Rahman (Rehman ke bande) ki dua — ghar ki khushi aur deen me bulandi ke liye.

arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
title: Mushkil kaam se pehle (Musa AS ki dua)
transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
urdu: Aye mere Rab! Mera seena khol de, mera kaam asan kar de, aur meri zaban ki girah khol de taake wo meri baat samjhen.
virtue: Musa (AS) ne Firaun ke samne jane se pehle ye dua mangi — interview, imtehan ya mushkil guftagu se pehle parhen.

arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
title: Ilm me izafa
transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.
urdu: Aye mere Rab! Mere ilm me izafa farma.
virtue: Sab se chhoti aur taqatwar dua — talib-e-ilm roz parhe.

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
title: Be-sahari me rizq ki dua
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
urdu: Aye mere Rab! Jo bhalai Tu meri taraf utare, main us ka mohtaj hun.
virtue: Musa (AS) ne jab be-sahara the ye dua mangi — uske baad rizq aur sahara dono mile.

arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
title: Har gham ka ilaj — Hasbunallah
transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
urdu: Allah hamein kafi hai, aur wo behtareen karsaz hai.
virtue: Sahaba ne dushman ke khauf par ye kaha to Allah ne farmaya: wo iman me aur barh gaye.

arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
title: Yunus (AS) ki dua — har hajat ke liye
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
urdu: Tere siwa koi mabood nahi, Tu pak hai, beshak main zalimon me se tha.
virtue: Yunus (AS) ne machhli ke pet me parhi. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: jo musalman is dua se kuch mange, Allah qubool farmata hai (Tirmidhi 3505).

arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
title: Musibat par sabr ki dua
transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.
urdu: Beshak hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautne wale hain.
virtue: Musibat par ye kehne walon par Allah ki rehmaten aur hidayat ka wada hai (2:157).

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
title: Fajr ke baad — ilm, rizq, qubool amal
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
urdu: Aye Allah! Main tujh se nafa dene wala ilm, pakiza rizq aur qubool hone wala amal mangta hun.
virtue: Nabi ﷺ Fajr ki namaz ke baad ye dua mangte the — din ka behtareen aghaz.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
title: Har namaz ke baad ki wasiyat
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik.
urdu: Aye Allah! Apne zikr, apne shukr aur apni behtareen ibadat par meri madad farma.
virtue: Nabi ﷺ ne Mu'adh (RA) ko wasiyat ki: har namaz ke baad ye dua kabhi na chhorna.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
title: Ni'mat ke zawal se panah
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik.
urdu: Aye Allah! Main teri panah chahta hun teri ni'mat ke zawal se, teri aafiyat ke palat jane se, tere achanak azab se aur tere tamam ghazab se.
virtue: Sehat, rizq aur sukoon ki hifazat ki jami' dua.

arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
title: Dil ki sabit qadmi
transliteration: Ya muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik.
urdu: Aye dilon ko pherne wale! Mere dil ko apne deen par sabit rakh.
virtue: Nabi ﷺ aksar ye dua mangte the — dil Allah ke hath me hai.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
title: Laylatul Qadr ki dua
transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun, tuhibbul-'afwa, fa'fu 'anni.
urdu: Aye Allah! Tu muaf karne wala hai, muafi ko pasand karta hai, pas mujhe muaf farma.
virtue: Aisha (RA) ne poocha: Laylatul Qadr mil jaye to kya mangu? Nabi ﷺ ne ye dua sikhayi.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
title: Subah/sham — har nuqsan se hifazat
transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama', wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
urdu: Allah ke naam se, jis ke naam ke sath zameen o aasman ki koi cheez nuqsan nahi de sakti, aur wo sunne wala, janne wala hai.
virtue: Subah/sham 3 martaba parhne wale ko koi cheez nuqsan nahi degi.

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
title: Har shar se panah — sham ki dua
transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
urdu: Main Allah ke mukammal kalimaat ki panah chahta hun, us ki makhluq ke shar se.
virtue: Sham ko 3 martaba parhne wale ko zehreela janwar nuqsan nahi dega.

arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
title: Allah ki raza ka wada
transliteration: Raditu billahi rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi Muhammadin (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam) nabiyya.
urdu: Main Allah ke Rab hone, Islam ke deen hone aur Muhammad ﷺ ke Nabi hone par raazi hun.
virtue: Subah/sham kehne wale se Allah Qiyamat ke din raazi hoga.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
title: Subah/sham ki jami' dua — aafiyat
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahumma-stur 'awrati, wa amin raw'ati. Allahumma-hfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa 'an yamini, wa 'an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi 'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.
urdu: Aye Allah! Main tujh se duniya aur akhirat me muafi aur aafiyat mangta hun. Aye Allah! Mere deen, duniya, ghar walon aur maal me muafi aur aafiyat de. Mere aeb chhupa de, mere dil ko aman de, aur meri aage, peeche, daen, baen aur upar se hifazat farma. Main teri azmat ki panah chahta hun neeche se halak kiye jane se.
virtue: Nabi ﷺ subah aur sham ye duayen kabhi na chhorte the.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
title: 100 martaba — samandar ke jhag jitne gunah maaf
transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi. (100 martaba)
urdu: Allah pak hai aur usi ki hamd hai. (100 martaba)
virtue: Din me 100 martaba kehne wale ke gunah maaf — chahe samandar ke jhag ke barabar hon.

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
title: Jannat ka khazana
transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
urdu: Gunah se bachne ki taqat aur neki ki quwwat sirf Allah ki madad se hai.
virtue: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: ye Jannat ke khazanon me se ek khazana hai.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
title: Sayyidul Istighfar — sab se afzal istighfar
transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi, la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika ma istata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi dhanbi, faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta.
urdu: Aye Allah! Tu mera Rab hai, tere siwa koi mabood nahi. Tune mujhe paida kiya aur main tera banda hun. Main apne ahd aur wade par qaim hun jitna ho sake. Main apne kiye ke shar se teri panah chahta hun. Main teri ni'maton ka iqrar karta hun aur apne gunah ka iqrar karta hun, pas mujhe bakhsh de, kyunke tere siwa koi gunah nahi bakhshta.
virtue: Sab se afzal istighfar — din ya raat me yaqeen se parh kar marne wala Jannati hai.

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
title: Roz 100 martaba istighfar
transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh. (100 martaba)
urdu: Main Allah se bakhshish mangta hun aur us ki taraf ruju karta hun. (100 martaba)
virtue: Nabi ﷺ roz 100 martaba Allah se istighfar karte the.
